name: Mohamed Arslan — WF-13 Telegram Callback Router

parameters.query: SELECT job_id, status FROM content_jobs WHERE job_id = $1 LIMIT 1;

UPDATE content_jobs
SET status = $2, approved_by = $3, approved_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW()
WHERE job_id = $1
RETURNING job_id, status;

INSERT INTO job_events (job_id, event_type, workflow_name, execution_id, payload)
VALUES ($1, 'TELEGRAM_CALLBACK_PROCESSED', 'Mohamed Arslan — WF-13 Telegram Callback Router', $2, $3::jsonb);

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$json.job_id, $execution.id, JSON.stringify({ action: $("05 Determine Target State").item.json.action, approvedBy: $("05 Determine Target State").item.json.fromUser })] }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ callback_query_id: $("05 Determine Target State").item.json.callbackId, text: "Action processed: " + $("05 Determine Target State").item.json.action, show_alert: false }) }}

parameters.content:
WF-13 Telegram Callback Router
Validates incoming Telegram callback user against TELEGRAM_ALLOWED_USER_IDS, extracts action and jobId, updates DB job status, logs event, and answers callback.
